newsitem.title: USA: Delgratia to appeal Nasdaq delisting.
newsitem.headline: Delgratia to appeal Nasdaq delisting.

text.p: Delgratia Mining Corp said on Thursday that it intends to appeal the NASDAQ Qualifications Hearing Panel's decision to delist the company's stock from The Nasdaq Market.

"The directors believe the company's properties in Nicaragua and Mexico are deserving of further exploration and that the company has the financial and technical resources needed to carry out its exploration and development programs," the company said in a statement.
Delgratia said none of its officers or directors engaged in insider trading. The company also said it disclosed all material information and was a victim of fraud.
The company said it intends to qualify its stock for the Over-the-Counter Trading Bulletin Board.
The company's shares were suspended after reports found evidence of tampering with core samples from the Vancouver-based gold mining company's Nevada property.
